script: Napoleon's elite guards wore giant bear fur hats into battle, and the hats did nothing but make them look taller. The bearskin cap had no armor value at all. Its only purpose was to make soldiers look bigger and more terrifying on the battlefield. It was so impractical that armies eventually kept it only for parades, never real combat. Napoleon's elite guards wore giant bear fur hats, purely for show.
